text:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions (us-west) for model-group: redwood-chat-xl. Triggered alert: chat.completions.p99 > 1200ms across 5m window.

Alex: I’m on it. seeing an uptick in queue depth and a couple of 503s from the shard serving redwood-chat-xl. starting a quick triage.

Maya: Noted customer-facing errors? any big tenants affected?

Alex: Quick look at traces — a single host pool hit a thermal throttle on GPU, autoscaler attempted to spin new nodes but k8s pod scheduling hit node affinity race. Some requests got routed to fallback models which increased latencies.

Prashant: Can we temporarily adjust routing to prefer redwood-chat-lg for non-high-priority customers to reduce pressure?

Alex: Yes. Adding a temporary route override for "tier:free" -> redwood-chat-lg for 10m. Applying now.

Julia: I’ll send a quick status update to #incidents and flag top 3 affected customers. 

Emily: FYI adding a short-term KV-cache warm on the affected prefix groups might help p95. Alex can you enable prefix caching for the busiest routes?

Alex: Enabled prefix cache (kv warm) for routes: /v1/chat/completions?route=assistant_gen and /v1/chat/completions?route=summarize. Also bumped cache TTL to 30m.

SRE-Bot: Action taken: routing override + cache warm. Watch window starts now.

Maya: After routing override, p99 dropped from ~1.8s to ~0.9s within 2m. p95 stable at ~300ms. Looking better.

Prashant: Good. We should also tweak alerting to reduce noise during these transient autoscaler races. Current alert: chat.completions.p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Propose: keep threshold, but change evaluation window to 10m for p99 and add per-route grouping to avoid one noisy route paging everyone.

Julia: Proposed alert query (Grafana alert rule) I pushed to the draft rule repo:

```
A = avg_over_time(api_latency_ms{route=~"/v1/chat/completions.*",model_group="redwood-chat.*"}[10m])
B = quantile_over_time(0.99, api_latency_ms{route="/v1/chat/completions?route=assistant_gen",model_group="redwood-chat-xl"}[10m])
alert: ChatCompletionsP99
expr: B > 1200
for: 10m
labels: { severity="pager" }
annotations: { summary="p99 latency high for chat completions (per-route)", runbook="runbook/eng-oncall/chat-p99" }
```

Maya: I like per-route quantile. Also suggest adding a noise gate: only page if >50% of routes in the model-group are above threshold, or if a single route sustained >2x baseline.

Alex: Agree. For short-term I'm going to set the alert to for: 15m with per-route grouping and add a squelch to avoid paging for low-traffic routes.

Emily: Can someone create a dashboard showing per-model p95/p99 by route and a column for scheduled autoscaler events and GPU thermal warnings? That will help reduce cognitive load in future incidents.

Prashant: Putting a TODO in the infra board: dashboard ticket created (#INFRA-1427). Will include panels: p95/p99 heatmap, request rate, queue depth, node autoscale events, thermal alarm overlay.

Julia: Also capturing customer impact: two mid-size tenants saw delayed responses and 5xx spikes for ~6 minutes but no data loss. Notifying Customer Success with timeline.

SRE-Bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please run post-incident follow-up and propose permanent alert rule changes.

Alex: Postmortem notes: root cause = transient GPU thermal throttle on pool-west-2 leading to autoscaler churn + scheduler race. Mitigations: 1) Improve node boot tags to reduce affinity race, 2) widen autoscaler cooldowns briefly to avoid oscillation, 3) implement per-route alerting and noise gate, 4) dashboard with autoscaler and thermal overlays.

Maya: For the alert playbook entry: add recommended thresholds per model tier: redwood-chat-xl p99=1200ms (pager), redwood-chat-lg p99=2000ms (ticket), low-traffic routes shouldn't page unless >50% error rate.

Prashant: I’ll open PR for the alert rule changes and include the noise-gate logic. Will also add a short-lived run of the new rule in staging before promoting.

Emily: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with CS and schedule a quick 30m post-incident review at 16:00 UTC.

Julia: Closing this thread once the PR is up and the staging run looks good. :thumbsup:
